capabilities: open .docx, .pptx, and .xlsx files read-only in Obsidian tabs
search and navigate rendered document text, slides, and worksheet cells
copy selected or whole-document text, Markdown, TSV, and formulas
create same-name Markdown summary notes linked to the source files
zoom, outline, and restore per-file reading state
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian Desktop 1.12.7+, no mobile support). Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Strictly read-only: never writes back to Office files. Further stability and support documentation is in STABILITY.md.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Microsoft Office documents natively, so reading .docx, .pptx, or .xlsx files kept in a vault requires leaving the app.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .docx, .pptx, and .xlsx files inside Obsidian with search, navigation, zoom, and linked Markdown summary notes.
